title: Accident Reports Wanted
content: Everyone's experience in dreams is subjective. However, I want to see if anyone witnessed one or more accidents or events in recent dreams. I'm not sure if a shared dreamspace is bound by spacetime (finite time but infinite space) or if exists in timespace (finite space but infinite time). Share your stories if these (hopefully non-leading) questions trigger a memory. There was an accident with a golf cart on a ramp. There were several witnesses that took action. What happened? There was an accident on an escalator. What were the details? Someone important was hanging around the food court. Tell me what you saw. There were two animal exhibits. Many people went down the stairs to look inside the enclosure. What animals did you see? And finally, there was a person racing around the mall on either a shopping cart (buggy) or on a rolling chair. What (if anything) happened?
